Cc: support@altitude.ai
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo today — cannot join

Hi Rachel,

We hit a weird issue trying to join the demo you scheduled for 10am PT. When I click the calendar entry "Join" link in GCal it either shows a 404 or presents a different organizer's Zoom token (some internal account). A couple of our attendees see the meeting but cannot get in — it looks like organizer metadata is pointing to an old test account.

I tried opening the calendar event and re-sending invites but that didn't clear it. Can we either: 1) get a fresh invite/ICS generated with you as organizer, or 2) provide a temporary Zoom link I can paste into the invite so attendees can join? We have execs on the call and don’t want to reschedule if we can avoid it.

Attendees: Mason Patel, Priya Rao (prod), Daniel Kim (sre)

Thanks,
Mason
Altitude AI

Hi Mason — thanks for the quick note and sorry for the chaos.

Quick diagnostic: this sounds like organizer-shadowing where the GCal organizer field still references a decommissioned account we used for internal tests. That causes the client to surface the old join token which fails our redirection rules. Ben, Jordan — flagging in case you want to escalate to infra; we’ll avoid escalation for now and do a pragmatic fix.

Proposed plan (short):
- I will create a NEW meeting (new Zoom link) with me as the organizer and send a fresh ICS to your attendees now.
- If you prefer to keep the original time, we will mark the old event as "canceled" and invite everyone to the new link; attendees will need to accept the new invite.
- If any attendee has strict SSO restrictions, Jordan will stand by to hand-provision the temporary join link.

I’m attaching a one-line troubleshooting checklist: re-accept invite, clear stale calendar cache (GCal web: More -> Refresh), and try the meeting link in an incognito window.

I’ll send the new invite in ~5 minutes and follow up here once done.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side after re-sending the calendar:

- We received your new ICS but one of our attendees (Daniel) still sees the old event in his calendar (likely cached). He accepted the new invite but when his client tries to generate a meeting join button it picks the old token.
- Priya is on macOS and her calendar cleared fine after we removed the old entry and re-synced.
- Daniel is using an older Exchange sync appliance; he can accept the new invite but his client doesn't always re-resolve organizer metadata immediately.

If you can provide a temporary Zoom join URL that we can paste into the body of the new event (so clients don't have to rely on the join button), that would be the fastest path to get everyone in. We can still accept a reschedule if needed but prefer the workaround for the execs’ availability.

Mason
